lines.en: Today is the day that Nodoka transfers into the class, but I’m assuming you could have figured that out based on how she is standing right in front of everyone right now.
I’m sure it will be a relatively normal introduction given that she’s proven to be a relatively normal girl thus far.
Well, when she’s not talking about her [incest] fetish.
But, now that I think about it, I guess every single introduction we’ve had in this class has been slightly out of the ordinary.
I think the current record holder would actually be Uta, who flavor beamed Makoto and proceeded to arm wrestle Yumi.
So yeah, it would be pretty hard to have a bad introduction by comparison.
: Good evening, everyone.
: My name is Nodoka Nagasawa and I will be transferring into this class starting today.
: Which one of you is Yumi?
Uh-oh.
: Nodoka!
: Yumi’s not here today! Did you want me to text her something?
: What a shame. I was looking forward to meeting her.
: Really? Then what can I-
: Leaving a message won’t be necessary. I’ll just proceed with the rest of my introduction and meet her some other time.
: Natsume Soseki once said, “Like the first whiff of burning incense, or like the taste of one's first cup of saké, there is in love that moment when all its power is felt.”
: Now, I don't know much about love. But I can tell each and every one of you that this, too, is a moment of great power.
: For I see it as the first step toward the rest of eternity.
: I’m sure there are plenty memories to be made here...plenty of fun experiences for all of us to have together.
: Living through all of that with you is why I exist now.
: And while I may not feel the specific power Soseki mentioned in this very moment, I’m sure that I will look back on it only to be swallowed whole.

: Swallowed by the nostalgic waves of[school] life as if it were every first sip of sake in the entire world, formed into a single tidal wave approaching our bodies quicker than we’re approaching graduation.
: As if it were a cloud of incense smoke laced with the same scents that bring us comfort when we lay our heads to our pillows at night.
: I do not expect to change your lives, nor do I expect you to change mine.
: But what I do expect is to enjoy the time we all have together, for it will be gone long before that smoke dissipates.
: Did we...
: Did we get a normal girl?
: Hey, isn’t that the super smart girl from our old[school]?
: The one who kinda just sat in the library all day and never went to any classes or anything?
: I never went to the library at our old[school], so I wouldn’t know.
: That’s gotta be her. But why would she be in a class like this?
: I never would’ve wound up in the same room as her if we were going by the old[school]’s rules. I’m like a gajillion levels below her.
: You’re a gajillion levels below everybody, Uta. But that’s okay. We all still love you anyway.
: Can I leave now? I have a class to teach.
I walk over to Wakana in the middle of Nodoka’s speech to see if she needs a hug or something.
: Sorry, but Nodoka was insistent on you watching her introduction.
: I don’t understand why. She’s supposed to be your problem now.
: If I knew I’d be spending even more time in this room, I would have just continued to deal with her on my own.
: But the last introduction you were here for was so memorable.
: Yes. It was simply delightful watching a girl with brightly colored hair talk about falling in love with you before she was even able to walk.
: People learn how to walk before they’re six years old, Wakana.
: Why? Do they not realize how exhausting walking is?
: They should spend every waking moment simply sitting around until people start asking them for things.
: ...Okay, Wakana. You can leave now.
: Thank you. And it’s Miss Watabe, you spineless prick.
: I want to fucking die. Goodbye.
Wakana exits the classroom and I make my way back over to the podium, hoping that Nodoka hasn’t noticed.
: Alas, my dearest Miss Watabe. Now truly is the winter of our discontent.
: She’ll be back. I wouldn’t worry about it.
: I miss her already.
: Cool. Is your speech over yet?
: Not quite. There is one thing I still have to do. And I apologize in advance for any commotion it may cause.
: What are you going to do, Nodoka?
: Something a friend of mine has assured me can not possibly go wrong.
: I learned recently that the best way to make a good impression in this class is by proclaiming your love in front of everyone.
: Oh no.
: Hey! She got that idea from me!
: You don’t...actually think your introduction worked out in your favor, right?
: Of course not. But I wasn’t going to just stand there and let the man of my dreams think I’m just some normal girl.
: I say good on Nodoka for following her heart.
: Uh-huh.
: But didn’t she go home with Sensei yesterday? What if her heart belongs to the same guy yours does?
: They did not “go home” together. They went on a mission to my old stomping grounds that I couldn’t be there for since I had work.
: And if they fell in love during that mission?
: Well?
: Shut up.
: Sensei is mine and no one else is allowed to fall in love with him.
: Hi!
: I like your hair.
: Thanks.
: I like yours too.
: Even though I may be as fresh in your minds as the morning dew...I, too, have a heart.
: And that heart has been beating nonstop since I laid my eyes on someone in this very classroom.
: If one more girl lays her stupid eyes on Sensei I’m blowing the[school] up.
: Oh god! What if it’s me?! Makoto! Are girls even allowed to date girls here?!
: As long as there are no public displays of affection, of course. The same goes for heterosexual couples.
: Also, stop interrupting her introduction! This is the closest we’ve had to a normal student since the[school] year started and I will not let you ruin it!
: Since the dawn of time, the core fundamental of all living things has been the same...To survive.
: To survive, you must not only defend yourself, but mate. Reproduce.
: To carry on and strengthen the lineage. To grow, like trees.
: And for that reason, I have selected who I will be spending the rest of my life with.
: And that person is...
: Futaba Fukuyama!
: What?!
: Ami! This is great news!
: This means our chances of ending up with Sensei stay exactly the same instead of getting worse again!
: Yeah! This is the best news I’ve heard all-
: Wait! Stop hitting on my [uncle]!
: It’s not biologically possible for us to reproduce, Nodoka!

: Futaba has a girlfriend before me. Futaba has a girlfriend before me.  Futaba has a girlfriend before me.  Futaba has a girlfriend before me.  Futaba has a girlfriend before me.  Futaba has a girlfriend before me.
: Don’t worry, life-partner! I’m already in the process of researching how it would be possible for us to naturally conceive!
: It's not looking good so far, but how do you feel about starting on supplements just in case?
: Bad!
: What kind of supplements are you even thinking of?!
: Two mothers. How beautiful.
: I wonder how many fathers would be required.
: I will have to ask the Emerald Guardian to teach me about reproduction soon.
: My dearest Futaba, are you rejecting me? After all of these years? After all of the laughs we have shared? The breasts we have compared?!
: Yes! Stop giving people the wrong idea!
: I don’t believe you!
: Come! Let us consummate our future together on Miss Watabe’s desk!
: Two girls...in a relationship together...
: Is that sort of thing...common?...
: Uhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh...
: Do you not, like...know about bisexuals and lesbians and stuff, Sana?
: O-Of course I know about them! I’ve just never talked to any...so...it’s a little confusing to me.
: Well...is there anything in particular you’re confused about?...
: I don't know...
: Can you...maybe just...teach me everything that you know?...
: Ah! Rin! Your nose!
: Wha-
: How on earth could something like this happen?!
: What a strange turn of events that I don’t understand in any way at all!
: Is there anything I can do to...make you feel better?...
: NOPE! TOTALLY GOOD! THANKS, SANA!
: Oh...okay...
: Well...tell me if you change your mind...
: Yup! Mind is totally under control! Definitely nothing weird going on in there! Hahahahah!
: Haha...hah...
: Okay, I think that’s a long enough introduction.
: You’ve already caused several of the girls to start spiraling into chaos, so I think it’s safe to say you’ve done your job now.
: Sensei, need I remind you that all I’m doing is creating memories?
: I get that. But it's starting to get loud in here.
: But Futaba and I were this close to finally hooking up.
: We were not, Nodoka!
: See? She’s all about it.
: Sensei, if the introduction is over, do you think I could have a minute of your time?
: Go ahead, Sensei. I’ll maintain order in the classroom.
: I’m sure you will...
: What’s up?
: I just wanted to bring something I heard from the principal to your attention.
: Do you know anyone by the name of Otoha Okakura?
: Oh, yeah. She’s a friend of several of the girls here.
: Is she transferring in already?
: Well, you have to sign off on the form still, but yes. She’s been approved.
: Great. Is that the end of our meeting then?
: Well, not exactly.
: It’s true that the matter with Otoha was the most urgent, but there is something else that is concerning to me as well.
: You? Concerned? That doesn’t sound good to me.
But hey, as long as it doesn’t lead to her freaking out and deliriously offering a dual blowjob with her best friend again, I’m sure it will be fine.
: The thing is, we were supposed to be getting cut off from new students at sixteen since that’s all the[school] thinks you’re able to handle.
: That’s actually rather generous of them given how I’ve been lately.
: It really is, but that’s beside the point.
: Because I found out today that two more girls after this Otoha character will be transferring in. And each of them requires special care.
: Oh, I can handle “special care.”
: Oh, I am well aware of how you are with “special care.” But that’s not what I’m talking about.
: Well then what do they need exactly?
: One of them appears to be the daughter of an extremely wealthy family- even moreso than Ayane's.
: So we've been urged to essentially just...give her anything she wants whenever she wants.
: And I have no idea why, but it seems that you were personally requested to be her teacher.
Personally? And someone even more wealthy than Ayane?
The Dojo girl?
: That’s strange. I don’t really understand why she would-
Wait a second.
Didn't that rich woman at the onsen mention having another daughter?
: Chika, do you remember Tsubasa’s last name?
: Hm? It was Tsukioka. Why? What’s up?
: Tsubasa?
: Where were you with Chika that you wound up running into the apparent mother of the richest family in Kumon-mi?
: A petting zoo. It was completely wholesome.
: Anyway, who is the second girl?
: See, this is the part that really confuses me.
: She doesn’t have any parental or guardian signatures on any of her paperwork, which isn’t a problem on its own since there are several girls in[school] in similar conditions-
: But I think there was an issue with Kumon-mi Academy’s data backup server as her entire student file is a mix between blank pages and redacted statements.
: The only note I could find just mentioned “special care.”
: I’ve never seen anything like it before.
: I do have her name, but...that doesn't really help us at all.
: Well, at least tell me that.
: It’s Yasu Yasui.
: I wasn’t even able to speak with any of her teachers since every single one of them hung up on me as soon as I asked about her.
: Well...I guess there’s really no way of telling what she’ll be like until we meet her then, right?
: Right...but it’s still strange. So I just wanted to do my part in letting you know.
: Well thanks. I appreciate it.
: Meeting adjourned? I want to take a nap.
: Um...no. There was one more thing. But I guess it’s not really that important.
: Okay, fine. What is it?
: I was just wondering...and it’s okay if you say no-
: But I was wondering if maybe you’d like to...accompany me somewhere soon.
: That depends, I guess. Where did you have in mind?
: Well...our next beach trip is coming up in a month or two, and I wanted to make sure the facilities were still...up to par.
: And it’s not like the two of us got to spend much time together there last time, so...
: The beach trip is coming up?
: Isn’t it the middle of winter?
: They’re open all year. The season won’t change anything.
: I’m sure it won’t be as fun as it was in the summer, but-
: Wait...but how would we have gone with you in the summer when the[school] year didn’t start until...
: Sure, yeah. I’ll go.
: You will?!
: Sure. I think it sounds fun.
: Perfect! Just let me know whenever you're ready and I’ll make the arrangements!
: You’re going to have to pay, though.
: I’d ask my mom, but I don’t think she’d be keen on the idea of the two of us going on a mini vacation together.
: Inviting me on a trip and making me pay? Classic Makoto.
: How is this classic Makoto? I have never done anything like this before.
: You haven’t. But it feels like you have.
: ...What?
: Nothing. I’m going to take a nap now.
: I’ll call you when I’m ready to go, though.
Congratulations! You have unlocked a special trip with Makoto!
Try calling her on a Saturday afternoon after you've tied up any loose ends with her best friend.
The rest of the day goes by normally, with things not settling down until it’s nearly time to leave.
It sounds like Otoha will be transferring in soon-
Which means I should probably start scotchguarding all of the corners and desks so Rin won’t crack her skull open when she inevitably faints from excitement.
The classroom really is getting livelier by the day...
Nodoka’s affection has increased to [nodoka_love]!
